gates.title: Ordinary CI
gates.acceptance_scope: general formatting, lint, tests, generated contracts, and selected packaging/dependency checks

gates.title: Wake Word required gates manifest audit
gates.acceptance_scope: policy manifest integrity and required-gate inventory drift detection

gates.title: Wake Word deterministic corpus manifest gate
gates.acceptance_scope: fixture schema, provenance, license, privacy, and pending acceptance-criteria policy

gates.title: Wake Word corpus contract gate
gates.acceptance_scope: Python companion validation for the active docs/wake-word-corpus.json schema

gates.title: Native packaging/architecture policy gate
gates.acceptance_scope: hosted policy checks for pinned runtime manifest, architecture rejection, and cache/hash behavior

gates.title: Lifecycle stability gate
gates.acceptance_scope: deterministic runtime-manager state-machine stability tests

gates.title: Settings/listener lifecycle acceptance
gates.acceptance_scope: ordinary CI Rust and frontend tests for live Settings enable-disable paths, listener diagnostics, and listener lifecycle transitions

gates.title: Manual shared-capture transfer acceptance
gates.acceptance_scope: ordinary CI Rust tests for manual command ownership transfer, Wake listener stop-resume boundaries, and duplicate microphone stream prevention

gates.title: Selected ASR policy acceptance
gates.acceptance_scope: ordinary CI and disclosure tests proving Wake-triggered command ASR remains local-Moonshine-only and unsupported modes fail before listening

gates.title: Downstream first-command-word acceptance
gates.acceptance_scope: deterministic router and local-ASR ingress tests proving wake pre-roll and the first command word reach the downstream command boundary in order

gates.title: Clean-install artifact provisioning acceptance
gates.acceptance_scope: native packaging and artifact manifest tests proving clean app-data installs fail closed until pinned Wake artifacts are prepared and verified

gates.title: Performance evidence policy gate
gates.acceptance_scope: performance-report schema and pending-measurement policy

gates.title: Production listener performance evidence
gates.acceptance_scope: representative production native listener startup, idle capture CPU, memory, routing latency, wake-to-command, pre-roll, repeated-cycle, and continuous-ASR comparison measurements

gates.title: Privacy/security source audit gate
gates.acceptance_scope: diagnostic privacy, sanitized error surfaces, and private-audio guardrails

gates.title: Documentation truthfulness audit
gates.acceptance_scope: truthful behavior/gate documentation while real acceptance remains pending

gates.title: Source/security ownership audit gate
gates.acceptance_scope: single runtime ownership, capture routing, artifact/architecture checks, and no idle network/full-ASR dependency

gates.title: Linux x86_64 real KWS acceptance
gates.acceptance_scope: real positive and negative pinned sherpa KWS inference on Linux x86_64 using the generated deterministic corpus and exact frozen model/runtime identities

gates.title: macOS arm64 real KWS acceptance
gates.acceptance_scope: real positive and negative pinned sherpa KWS inference on macOS arm64 using the generated deterministic corpus and exact frozen model/runtime identities

gates.title: Integrated production lifecycle acceptance
gates.acceptance_scope: repeated wake to ASR to Thinking to Talking to wake cycles with resource counts

gates.title: Measured performance acceptance
gates.acceptance_scope: representative Linux and macOS CPU, memory, latency, repeated-cycle, and continuous-ASR comparison measurements
